text: Backlog created from the 2026-10-24 end-to-end pass: 41 issues (1 P0, 8 P1, 14 P2, 18 P3). Production queues and indexes provisioned for SYN-001.
SYN-001 done: PR #1 merged and deployed to production (health ok, queue consumer attached, migrations applied). Added SYN-042: docs-only pushes to main redeploy production.

Folded the May production-readiness audit into the backlog: 48 items checked against the code — 17 fixed or not applicable, 15 linked to existing issues, 15 new (SYN-043 to SYN-057, including P1 SYN-043: interviewers can change recruiter data). SYN-036 corrected to a display bug.

SYN-043 fixed in PR #2 (interviewers scoped on every route; route-coverage test added); Safari pass green, awaiting merge. Found during the pass: SYN-058 (resume/JD previews blank in Safari, P1) and SYN-059 (AI question failures are silent, P2).
SYN-043 done: PR #2 merged and deployed to production (health ok). Interviewers are now limited to their own interviews and the candidate and job of those interviews.
Added SYN-060 (P1): the security headers in next.config.mjs never reach production on Cloudflare Pages, so production has no CSP or clickjacking protection. To be fixed together with SYN-058.

SYN-058 + SYN-060 fixed in PR #3: security headers now come from the middleware (so production finally gets them) and framing is same-origin, which unblocks Safari resume/JD previews. Logged SYN-061 (no Word download in interview room), SYN-062 (UTC date hydration error), SYN-063 (AI verdict shown as resume summary).

SYN-058 + SYN-060 done: PR #3 merged and deployed. Production now serves CSP, clickjacking protection, HSTS and nosniff; Safari previews unblocked. Logged SYN-064: a wrong password shows "Session expired" (seen on production).
Logged SYN-065 (interviewer Today tab uses the UTC date) and SYN-066 (interviews under 24 h away get an instant reminder), found while drafting SYN-002.

SYN-002 + SYN-027 fixed in PR #4: interviews are saved in the picked time zone (emails show it too, migration 0010), the picker defaults to your zone, and past days/times are blocked in the form and the API. Live Chrome pass green; awaiting merge.
SYN-002 + SYN-027 done: PR #4 merged and deployed. Interviews are saved in the picked time zone (migration 0010 live), emails show that zone, and past times are refused.
SYN-004 diagnosed via SendGrid's API: free account, 0 credits, no reset since 1 July 2026. Needs a decision: upgrade SendGrid or switch to Resend.

SYN-004 in progress: SendGrid removed, Brevo added with a config-switchable fallback to Resend (branch fix/syn-004-email-brevo, tests green, live test waiting on the Brevo key). Logged SYN-067: email failures are invisible because logs carry no company.
SYN-004: live test passed locally (real email delivered through Brevo, fallback from Resend to Brevo works) and PR #5 is open. Waiting on the production Brevo secret before merging.

SYN-004: PR #5 merged and deployed to production. Brevo is live (secret stored, settings updated, migration 0011 applied, email job running cleanly). Still open until one real production email is confirmed.
SYN-004 done: a real interview email was sent from production through Brevo and reported delivered. The fake candidate address was skipped as designed.
